text:
emma_cs: FYI customer GreenLine says their QA tests started returning confidently wrong company facts after our 02:00 UTC rollout. They're seeing a lot more assertive but incorrect statements.

aj_eng: ugh, thanks for the ping. any repro examples?

emma_cs: pasted one from their log: prompt => "Summarize GreenLine's founding and founders." response => "GreenLine was founded in 2016 by Alex Harper and Lina Zhou, focused on logistics automation." (customer says GreenLine was actually founded 2012 and founders are different). they say this pattern shows up across product descriptions and timeline queries.

nora_prod: did they include the exact model param in the call? might be a routing variant.

emma_cs: they captured the request: \`model: redwood-v3-alloc\`, \`route: us-west-1:low-latency\`, content-type json, streaming off. They said it started after yesterday's packaged-model swap at ~02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Hosted Canary: packaged-model-swap v3.1 -> v3.2 deployed to 10% traffic at 2026-03-09T02:05:12Z by nora_prod. :rocket:

kai_ml: thanks — can we get a minimal repro? ask them to hit the same prompt without system priming and include the full request/response headers. also need model config: temperature, max_tokens, top_p, any function-calling.

emma_cs: quick repro they supplied (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-v3-alloc", "prompt": "Summarize GreenLine's founding and founders.", "temperature": 0.0, "max_tokens": 80 }
```
response (customer):
```
GreenLine was founded in 2016 by Alex Harper and Lina Zhou. The company started as a small logistics startup...
```
they emphasize the tone is confident and specific — not hedged.

aj_eng: temp=0.0 and still hallucinating hard is suspicious. possible causes: model param drift, new knowledge patch that introduced wrong KB, or a reranking/decoding change in runtime. i can take a look at kernel/decoding flags for the v3.2 rollout.

tony_support: customer also dropped a few more examples in csv: fabricated launch dates for product features and swapped partner names. requests are lower-volume but high-impact. they're asking for status and mitigation ASAP.

kai_ml: can we run their prompt set through both v3.1 (previous) and v3.2 (current) offline and diff outputs? i can run a 50-example eval. need the prompt bundle.

nora_prod: copying the canary rollout config: no quantization changes, same beam/decoding defaults. the packaged-model swap included an updated tokenizer and a minor soft-prompt change intended to improve brevity.

aj_eng: tokenizer tweak + soft-prompt could change factual grounding in edge cases. also check routing: their requests went to low-latency pool which we recently switched to a gpt-like-attn kernel variant for perf. that kernel has a new kv-cache handling patch.

deploy-bot: [alert] Routing change: low-latency pool kernel variant switched to attn-opt v1.4 at 2026-03-09T01:58:40Z.

kai_ml: ok i'll run the diff and include confidence metrics and token-level attention traces. if v3.2 + attn-opt correlates to higher hallucination rate, we should roll back the kernel change from low-latency pool and throttle the canary.

emma_cs: customer is requesting rollback or targeted routing to previous variant while you investigate. they're queued to go into a stepped demo next week so this is blocking.

aj_eng: agree — temporary mitigation options: 1) route their customer id to dedicated previous variant (v3.1) using sticky-routing; 2) set a conservative decoding config (e.g., lower max_new_tokens or enable nucleus constraints) at gateway for that org; 3) rollback attn-opt v1.4 from low-latency pool.

nora_prod: i'll open a rollback canary and pin GreenLine's org to v3.1 for now. also recommend ops enable extra logging for any confident assertions (we can flag sentences with firm-date or founder tokens).

kai_ml: also plan to run calibration evals and compare logprobs on asserted facts between versions. will post results in this thread.

tony_support: i notified the customer that we're investigating and proposed pinning them to previous model as a short-term fix. they want a timeline.

emma_cs: thanks — i'll keep them updated. please drop ETA for rollback and the eval.

aj_eng: i'll start the rollback canary now, ETA ~20m for routing change and customer pin. will follow up with evidence.

kai_ml: placing the initial 50-example diff job now, expect first results in ~45m.

nora_prod: noted. logging action items: (1) pin GreenLine to v3.1, (2) extra inference logging for org, (3) run offline diffs and attention traces, (4) review tokenizer/soft-prompt delta.

emma_cs: appreciated. I'll include the csv of their examples in the ticket. :pray:
